gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-kaith: Noto Sans Kaithi is a plain sans with wide-open e shapes and lowercase that fills the line. Funnel Display brings wire-thin, uniform strokes up top, and that wiry commanding look against such sturdy letters is the pair's best card.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-kanna: Approachable from the first line, Noto Sans Kannada is a plain sans with a gentle step up to capitals. Funnel Display's wire-like strokes hold the top, while the body's s curves open wide and let a long page flow along easily.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-kayah: Noto Sans Kayah Li is a sans-serif with lifted brush ends and capitals barely taller than lowercase. Funnel Display swaps hairline joins for full-width connections, so its heading sits firm over a body that looks lightly sketched.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-kharo: Pencil lines up top, dark stripes below. Funnel Display sketches every letter at a single pressure, while Noto Sans Kharoshthi runs a thick band of lowercase through each line, its curves left open, so the two feel like drawing and ink.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-khojk: Noto Sans Khojki reads clean and modern, with a large, clear eye on every e and exits wide enough to pass light. Funnel Display's strokes hold constant width like bent pipe, so a long page of the body stays easy on the eye.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-khuda: Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps its capitals close to lowercase height and leaves its rounds unlatched, like open hooks. And Funnel Display, drawn with a marker-nib line, would feel cramped if shrunk, so give it room to be big.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-kr: Noto Sans KR has a big x-height, stubby ascenders and descenders, and generous gaps in its curves, all of it quietly practical. Funnel Display, with curves as heavy as stems like cord, supplies the loud part.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-lao: Tall lowercase, steady lines. Funnel Display keeps its weight unvarying, and Noto Sans Lao lifts its x-height well above the usual with mouths left open, so each font has an obvious job.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-lao-l: Funnel Display draws with the steadiness of a string. Noto Sans Lao Looped then lets words settle into solid blocks, its bowls left open on one side, so paragraphs read as a smooth, even texture down the page.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-lepch: Zero stroke contrast defines Funnel Display, every line pulled at the same pressure. Noto Sans Lepcha follows with wide-opening curves and lowercase as sturdy as cast iron capitals, so a long page feels solid yet approachable.
